messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up 1: vendor NimbusTech LLC reached out asking whether to submit a W-9 or W-8. They also flagged a clause about Redwood "grossing up" taxes in the contract. Can tax/legal confirm?

nimbus-acct: Hi Redwood finance 1: We are incorporated in the US as an LLC but >60% owned by a UK parent co. Our team asked if we should upload a W-9 or W-8. Contract attached in portal. Also our standard terms include a "gross-up" obligation for withholding. Please advise so we can get paid.

Jules AP: Tagging @Ben (Tax) and @Legal (Contracts). AP cannot approve invoice 4102 without a completed tax form.

Ben (Tax): Short answer: If their US LLC is a U.S. taxpayer with EIN and files as a US entity, they provide a W-9. Ownership by a foreign parent doesn't automatically make them foreign for IRS purposes. If they insist they're foreign, they must provide W-8BEN-E and supporting residency docs.

Samir Rao: Invoice 4102 shows NimbusTech LLC, San Jose address, no EIN printed. I've placed invoice on hold until we get a form.

Maya Patel: I asked them to upload a signed W-9 PDF with EIN and a copy of the contract page referencing gross-up. Also asked them to confirm legal entity exactly as appears on tax filings.

nimbus-acct: Uploaded W-9 to portal and added the contract excerpt. EIN provided: 12-3456789. Regarding gross-up, the clause in the SOW says: "Client will gross-up payments to ensure Supplier receives payment free of withholding tax."

invoice-bot: Invoice 4102 status: ON_HOLD 1: reason: pending tax form verification.

Legal (Contracts): Reviewing clause now. Our default policy: we do not accept unilateral gross-up obligations unless negotiated and approved by Legal + Finance. Need to check whether the SOW was signed as-is or if this was an external vendor template that should have been redlined.

Ben (Tax): I'll validate the EIN and W-9. If W-9 checks out, vendor treated as US payee 1: no withholding, and gross-up clause would be moot unless contract was negotiated to include it. If they later try to submit W-8 to claim treaty, we need certificate and evidence.

Jules AP: Noted. AP: payment hold to remain until Ben confirms and Legal signs off on gross-up exposure.

Samir Rao: Added AP note: "Awaiting W-9 verification + Legal decision on gross-up. Do not release funds."

Maya Patel: Quick Q for Legal: if the SOW contains that explicit language and was countersigned, do we need a commercial approval to refuse?

Legal (Contracts): If SOW was countersigned by Redwood with that clause intact, Legal needs to check execution history and whether someone approved it. If it's present and valid, Finance/Legal will evaluate cost impact; we may require a change order to remove gross-up or require higher fees. For now, don't pay.

nimbus-acct: Understood. We'll await confirmation. We can accept redline if required but wanted to follow original SOW.

Ben (Tax): EIN validated in IRS TIN match. W-9 is OK. From tax perspective, no withholding required. Recommendation: do not honor gross-up unless contract owner confirms commercial approval.

Jules AP: Thanks Ben. Legal 1: please advise commercial next steps. AP will keep invoice held.

Legal (Contracts): Looping in Commercial to see who approved that SOW. If no approval, we'll request amendment removing gross-up. If approved, Finance will flag exposure for escalation.

Maya Patel: Closing admin loop: AP will not pay until we have explicit Legal/Commercial direction on the gross-up clause. Ben: please mark vendor as US taxpayer in vendor master.

Ben (Tax): Done 1: marked US payee, no withholding.

invoice-bot: Invoice 4102 remains ON_HOLD. Last update: W-9 validated, pending Legal/Commercial decision on SOW gross-up clause.
